Oct 2 – Oct 16, 2026

Aura & Community Updates

Aura reached 1.0, DataGrid picked up the features data-heavy apps ask for most, and the community library gained maps, charts and full-page templates.

Highlights

Aura reached 1.0, DataGrid gained the selection, resizing and loading features data-heavy apps need, and the community library added a time-series chart.

Aura 1.0 is here

The first stable major release of @cognite/aura, now published from its new home.

About Aura →

A more capable DataGrid

Resizable columns, loading and empty states, row selection with an action toolbar, and readable dates.

View in Storybook →

Time-series chart for the community

A D3-based chart with zoom, brushing and Aura chart tokens is ready to install.

See the component →

Components

Six new components and templates landed, mostly in the community library, while DataGrid, the date pickers and Count picked up updates and fixes.

DateTimePicker

Aura
New

Pick a single date and time with the same API as Aura's other pickers.

View in Storybook →

Map

Community
New

An interactive map styled with Aura tokens, with composable markers and a light/dark basemap.

Time-series chart

Community

See the component →

Community template

DataGrid: columns and states

Aura
Update

Columns can now be resized, with new loading and empty states.

DataGrid: row selection

Aura
Update

DataGrid: readable dates

Aura
Fix

Date cells now show readable values instead of raw ISO strings.

Aura
Update

Aura

Context & skills

Eleven components gained portable docs, community installs now ship agent skills for charts and templates, and the install guide is clearer.
